title: 第459章 给你机会不珍惜第458章 前女友的儿子
slug: 赵老驴和杏花村的女人们
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：赵老驴和杏花村的女人们第一卷：默认第459章给你机会不珍惜（..la）这个陈四强和赵大柱有矛盾，而且还和女人有关。
所以李慧珍和李玉娇原本是不好掺和的，也不想掺和。
可现在陈四强都把话说到这个份上了，她们哪里还忍得住？
李慧珍当即说道：“我们跟大柱在一起，跟你没关系，用不着你在这里说三道四！”
李玉娇跟着说道：“没错，大柱他是什么样的男人，我们比你更清楚，不需要你在这里废话！”
陈四强暴跳如雷，指着赵大柱吼道：“好好好，一年没见你真的长本事了，竟然能把这两个女的迷得团团转！不过我告诉你，你的手段对我不管用，你今天说什么都别想踏进我们四儿子店大门一步！”
“我已经进来了。”赵大柱冷冷的说道。
“那就给我滚出去！”陈四强吼道。
“我要是不出去呢？”赵大柱说道。
“那你就不要怪我翻脸不认人了！保安！保安！”
陈四强厉声大喝，立即就有一大群身穿制服的保安冲了过来，他们刚刚来到这里，陈四强就指着赵大柱呵斥道：“这个老家伙带着两个女人在咱们店里闹事，影响咱们店的正常生意，你们立刻把他们赶出去，绝对不允许他们踏入咱们四儿子店一步！”
随着陈四强一声令下，这些个保安立即就如狼似虎的冲了过来。
李慧珍和李玉娇顿时被吓得花容失色，不过她们两个立即就躲到了赵大柱的身后，而且一点也不害怕了。
毕竟有赵大柱在这里，谁都别想伤害她们。
“陈四强你疯了，我是来看车买车的！”赵大柱勃然大怒厉声呵斥。
“就你这穷酸样儿，我们店里的车你买得起吗？滚滚滚，你要是不滚我就帮你滚！”陈四强喷着唾沫大吼。
说话间的功夫，这七八个凶神恶煞的保安就已经冲到赵大柱的面前了。
无奈之下赵大柱只好动手，噼里啪啦的将这几个保安全都打翻在地，痛的他们龇牙咧嘴，一时间竟无法从地上爬起。
不过赵大柱下手还是很有分寸的，没有真的伤到他们，这几个保安在地上躺一会儿，缓过劲来就没什么事了。
看到赵大柱这么轻松的就将七八个体格魁梧的保安打翻在地了，远处那些顾客和工作人员全都惊呆了，无不感慨赵大柱战力超群。

就连陈四强也被赵大柱给吓到了。
但就在这时，一声雷霆大吼从楼上传来。
“出什么事了怎么闹成这样，谁这么无法无天，敢在我的地盘上闹事，活腻歪了是不是！”
从楼上跑下来的人不是别人，正是这家四儿子店的老板王光辉。
看到王光辉被吸引过来了，陈四强立即就迎了过去而且还恶人先告状。
“老板，这个老家伙跑到咱们店里闹事，我让他走，他不走，而且他还动手打伤了咱们店里的保安！”陈四强愤愤道。
于是王光辉立即就扭头朝赵大柱看了过来，并骂道：“哪个老不死的这么大胆，居然敢打我的……咦，赵大爷，怎么是你啊！”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Zhao Laolu and the Women of Xinghua Village Volume 1: Default Chapter 459: Don’t cherish the opportunity given to you (..la) This Chen Siqiang has a conflict with Zhao Dazhu, and it is also related to women.
Therefore, Li Huizhen and Li Yujiao were not easy to get involved with, and they did not want to get involved.
But now that Chen Siqiang has spoken out to this extent, how can they still hold back?
Li Huizhen said immediately: "We are with Dazhu, it has nothing to do with you, there is no need for you to make irresponsible remarks here!"
Li Yujiao then said: "Yes, we know better than you what kind of man Dazhu is, and we don't need you to talk nonsense here!"
Chen Siqiang was furious, pointed at Zhao Dazhu and shouted: "Okay, okay, I haven't seen you in a year, you are really good at it, and you can actually charm these two women! But let me tell you, your method will not work on me. If you say anything today, don't even think about stepping into the door of our fourth son's store!"
"I've already come in." Zhao Dazhu said coldly.
"Then get out of here!" Chen Siqiang shouted.
"What if I don't go out?" Zhao Dazhu said.
"Then don't blame me for turning against me! Security! Security!"
Chen Siqiang shouted loudly, and immediately a large group of uniformed security guards rushed over. As soon as they arrived, Chen Siqiang pointed at Zhao Dazhu and yelled: "This old guy brought two women to make trouble in our store, which affects the normal business of our store. You drive them out immediately, and they will never be allowed to step into our Fourth Son store!"
Following Chen Siqiang's order, these security guards immediately rushed over like wolves and tigers.
Li Huizhen and Li Yujiao were immediately frightened to death, but they immediately hid behind Zhao Dazhu and were not afraid at all.
After all, with Zhao Dazhu here, no one can harm them.
"Chen Siqiang, you're crazy, I'm here to see and buy a car!" Zhao Dazhu shouted angrily.
"You are so poor, can you afford the car in our store? Gungun, if you don't want to leave, I will help you leave!" Chen Siqiang yelled, spitting.
While he was talking, these seven or eight fierce security guards had already rushed in front of Zhao Dazhu.
In desperation, Zhao Dazhu had no choice but to take action and knocked all the security guards to the ground. They grinned in pain and were unable to get up from the ground for a while.
However, Zhao Dazhu was very measured in his actions and did not really hurt them. The security guards lay on the ground for a while and then they were fine after they calmed down.
Seeing Zhao Dazhu knocking seven or eight burly security guards to the ground so easily, the customers and staff in the distance were all shocked, and all sighed with emotion at Zhao Dazhu's superior combat power.
Even Chen Siqiang was frightened by Zhao Dazhu.
But at this moment, a thunderous roar came from upstairs.
"What happened? Why did it happen like this? Who is so lawless and dares to cause trouble on my territory? You are tired of living, aren't you?"
The person who ran down from upstairs was none other than Wang Guanghui, the owner of the Fourth Son store.
Seeing that Wang Guanghui was attracted, Chen Siqiang immediately rushed over and even complained first.
"Boss, this old guy came to our store to cause trouble. I asked him to leave, but he refused to leave. Moreover, he even injured the security guard in our store!" Chen Siqiang said angrily.
So Wang Guanghui immediately turned to look at Zhao Dazhu and cursed: "Which old man is so bold that he dares to hit me... Hey, Uncle Zhao, why is it you!"
